what: Estimated cost of the AI judge (Amazon Nova Pro) for one check of all 73 saved answers of the final run (results/bedrock-v3). No model was called to make this estimate.
how: Each judge prompt was rebuilt from the saved answer and tool calls exactly as scoring/checks.py builds it; tokens = characters / 4. The reply length is estimated from the number of checklist items the judge returned (about 70 characters per item plus a short reason).
note: In our test the judge ran twice (once in the Arize step, once in the Braintrust step). With one tool chosen, it runs once per test run.
